== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-06-underlord|The Dream Well is a source of purple [[water]] used to provide intense mental focus and invigorate those performing labor. Historically, its master utilized the liquid as a reward for successful workers or as a tool to assist those needing to complete projects without sleep. Conversely, it was also used as a method of punishment to ensure individuals remained fully aware of their consequences. The [[water]] can also influence sleep, smoothing out consciousness and turning rough or fearful rest into a deep, soft state. While its effects are highly effective for maintaining concentration and overcoming exhaustion, there is a potential for addiction to the substance.}}

== Ghostwater ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-05-ghostwater|The Dream Well is a well filled with clear, purple-tinted [[water]] that radiates qualities of focus and determination. Designed to eliminate mental fatigue in humans, the well's [[water]] can also be used for training purposes. [[Consuming]] the liquid helps smooth out consciousness and improve sleep quality, while also providing benefits to reaction speed. During his journey, [[Lindon]] drank from the well, and its waters were used to improve the mental state of [[Orthos]]. Additionally, [[Dross]] spent an extended period of time within the Dream Well.}}
